Your Next Step Awaits: Explore In-Depth Job Details and Apply with Ease. We’re looking for a Junior Python Developer/Trainer to join our team. This role involves building Python applications and training students or beginners in Python programming. Responsibilities Assist in developing and testing Python applications. Support in web development using Django or Flask. Conduct basic Python training sessions. Prepare simple assignments and guide learners. Help resolve coding doubts during training. Requirements Basic knowledge of Python and programming concepts. Good communication and presentation skills. Willingness to learn and help others learn. Any experience with Django/Flask or teaching is a plus. Hands-on experience in coding and teaching. Friendly and learning-focused environment. Growth opportunities in development and training. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Salary: USD 43200 - 72000 per year
